training_protocol: For each outer fold: Gate-21A TRAIN + other three factorial folds.
hyperparameter_selection: C selected independently for each fold using Gate-21A DEV only.
test_discipline: Gate-21A TEST used only for ID evaluation after C selection
outer fold never used for training
outer fold never used for C selection
every factorial state tested exactly once
reason_no_multiple_seeds: The present logistic-regression pipeline and deterministic benchmark are deterministic under the fixed solver/configuration; no stochastic training campaign is being claimed.
overfitting_controls: prospective protocol frozen before repair training
outer-fold exclusion from fitting and tuning
pooled prediction from each state tested once
claim_boundary: This is a prospective combinatorial generalization benchmark over a synthetic policy state space. It is not an external clinical dataset and must not be described as externally unseen real-world data.
